name: trica
description: Offline trigonometry triangle solver. Trica = TRIgonometry CAlculation.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json --noEmit && sass --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps style.scss:style.min.css -s compressed --no-source-map && offline-kit build
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx --yes concurrently -n tsc,sass,pwa,server -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run tsc:watch" "npm run style:watch" "npm run pwa:watch" "npm run start"
scripts.dev:no-sw: npm run build && npx --yes concurrently -n tsc,sass,pwa,server -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run tsc:watch" "npm run style:watch" "npm run pwa:watch" "npm run start -- --middleware=$PWD/scripts/disable-sw.js"
